info.name: ALOS API
info.description: Postman collection generated from the FastAPI OpenAPI schema.

item.name: Get Executive Dashboard
item.description: Return a read-only company snapshot from the Director's accessible workspaces.

item.name: Get Divisions Overview
item.description: Return division health derived only from the actor's accessible workspaces.

item.name: Get Project Portfolio
item.description: Return the filtered project portfolio without crossing workspace boundaries.

item.name: Record Release Decision
item.description: A Director records the human decision; PENDING is the safe initial state.

item.name: Login
item.description: Create an HttpOnly, same-site browser session without returning its token to JavaScript.

item.name: Get Model Policy
item.description: Model names are operational policy, while API credentials remain server-only secrets.

item.name: Bootstrap Local Registry Context
item.description: Create a local-only human/workspace context for the authenticated Agent Registry Builder.

item.name: Bootstrap Local Release Review Team
item.description: Issue local-only test tokens for distinct release lifecycle duties.

item.name: Create Genesis Follow Up
item.description: Return one idempotent, source-bound Genesis reply without advancing workflow.

item.name: Create Genesis Document Analysis
item.description: Bind one approved internal document to a reviewable Genesis analysis DRAFT.

item.name: Upload Genesis Document
item.description: Store a bounded original file and preview; it is not model-readable yet.

item.name: List Genesis Uploads
item.description: List upload metadata and previews without exposing raw binaries.

item.name: Get Genesis Upload
item.description: Read one upload's integrity metadata and bounded text preview.

item.name: Withdraw Genesis Upload
item.description: Erase an unpromoted upload while retaining only its immutable audit event.

item.name: Create Document Draft From Genesis Upload
item.description: Promote one complete upload to a checklist-bound canonical DRAFT only.

item.name: Create Document Draft
item.description: Create a canonical human document DRAFT; no publication occurs here.

item.name: Create Genesis Document Draft
item.description: Record a human requirement, then let Genesis prepare only a document skeleton DRAFT.

item.name: Register Tool Draft
item.description: A maker can only register a read-only Tool Registry draft.

item.name: Design Agent Draft
item.description: Genesis Designer is allowed to create a draft only, never an active agent.

item.name: Delete Agent Draft
item.description: Delete only mutable draft data; governed evidence always wins over deletion.

item.name: Get Validation Controls
item.description: Show draft/approved validation controls to the maker and independent reviewers.

item.name: Run Validation Fixture
item.description: Run one approved, source-enabled validation fixture through the shared Runtime.

item.name: Create Validation Agent Drafts
item.description:
Create only the three reviewed validation pilot contracts as Registry DRAFTs.

This endpoint does not approve a tool or policy, call a model, or release
an agent. Repeating it is safe when the current draft already matches.

item.name: Create Validation Control Drafts
item.description: Prepare unapproved read-only Tool and Permission Policy DRAFTs for validation.

item.name: Configure Source Vault
item.description: Set the Validation source boundary; this is metadata, not a Drive connection.

item.name: List Source Versions
item.description: Read source metadata and verification state without exposing source content.

item.name: Register Source Version
item.description: Register a textual source version; it is not retrievable until human verification.

item.name: Verify Source Version
item.description: An explicit human gate makes a source eligible for Runtime evidence retrieval.

item.name: Search Source Evidence
item.description: Show deterministic source citations that an approved read-only tool can retrieve.

item.name: Cancel Agent Run
item.description: Request durable cancellation for a queued or running Agent Run.

item.name: List Workspace Runs
item.description: Read-only execution telemetry for the future operations dashboard.

item.name: Get Workspace Usage
item.description: Read the same persisted daily ledger used by the cost guardrail.

item.name: List Audit Events
item.description: Only designated control roles may inspect the organization audit trail.
